map.交通气象安全提示 使用指南: Traffic Weather Safety Tips User Guide
map.输入能见度、路面温度、风速，综合评估低能见度、结冰、侧风等不利气象对交通安全的影: Enter visibility, road surface temperature and wind speed to assess how adverse weather such as low visibility, icing and crosswind affects traffic safety and output a warning level.
map.按能见度/路面温度/风给道路安全提示。: Give road safety advice by visibility, road surface temperature and wind.
map.雾、冻雨、横风路段分级预警。: Graded warnings for fog, freezing rain and crosswind sections.
map.导航叠加气象做限速/绕行建议。: Overlay weather on navigation for speed limit or detour advice.
map.：能见度 200 m → 属浓雾（<500m），提示开雾灯、限速 60、保持车距: : visibility 200 m -> dense fog (below 500 m), so use fog lights, limit speed to 60 and keep distance, and motorways may close.
map.：路面温度 −2°C 且有降水 → 结冰风险，提示装防滑链/禁行，桥面比普通路更: : road surface temperature −2 °C with precipitation -> icing risk, so fit snow chains or ban traffic; bridge decks freeze earlier than ordinary road.
map.≥1000m 正常、500–1000 较大影响、<500 浓雾（高速易封）、<2: At least 1000 m is normal, 500-1000 has a large effect, below 500 is dense fog (motorways close easily), below 200 is especially dense fog.
map.桥梁、风口、高速跨线桥，侧风使车辆偏移，大车尤甚，提示降速握稳。: Bridges, wind gaps and motorway overpasses, where crosswind pushes vehicles off line, especially large ones; the advice is to slow down and hold the wheel firmly.
